01 / About me

Learning. Creating. Becoming.

“Every great idea starts with the courage to stay curious.”

I'm Raj Pathak — a student, creator and lifelong learner in progress. I’m interested in personal growth, psychology, creativity and the way people see the world.

Through @inspireby.raj, I curate short-form podcast moments and conversations that make me pause, think and look at things differently.

This is my evolving digital home: a place to document the journey, showcase creative work and connect with people who value ideas.
